Definition
[Uniform equicontinuity] 1. appC:def-9\group Uniform Convergence The family $\{ f_k\} _{k=1}^\infty $ is uniformly equicontinuous if, for every $\varepsilon >0$, there exists $\delta >0$ such that \[ |x-y|<\delta \quad \Longrightarrow \quad |f_k(x)-f_k(y)|<\varepsilon \] for all $x,y\in \mathbb R^n$ and $k=1,2,\ldots $.
